audit.whatIsWrong: Chart read Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Cassiopeia. The prose disagrees at both ends: Level 1 is described as 'roughly even' and 'a coin flip', while Levels 3, 4-5 and First item are described as 'you flip it', 'you out-DPS any extended trade' and 'a dominant kiting DPS'.
audit.why: Lane difficulty is a key point; the chart understated four stages Cassiopeia owns and overstated Level 1.
audit.corrected: Skill / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia / Skill / Cassiopeia / Cassiopeia in both layers. Level 6 stays Skill because Hijack genuinely neutralises her spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 spike says to act 'when his R is down' without ever giving the number.
audit.why: Power spikes is a key point and the whole level-6 plan hinges on Hijack's downtime — which shrinks from 80s to 30s, so 'wait for his R' stops being a plan late.
audit.corrected: Hijack quoted as 80s at rank 1 and 30s at rank 3; Abscond/Abduct 13s to 9s and Kingslayer 12s added to the cooldown text.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry treats Kingslayer as a pure heal — it is a lunge, so Miasma grounds it exactly like Abscond, and the page never says so. It also never says that Petrifying Gaze only stuns targets facing you, which is the counter-play when Sylas Hijacks it and fires your own ult back. Sylas's sustain is never tied to Grievous Wounds. 'Twin Fangs' is used in spikes[2].
audit.why: Point 4 is the most important point. Grounding both of his dashes with one Miasma is the matchup, and turning your back to a stolen Gaze downgrades a stun to a slow.
audit.corrected: Miasma stated as grounding Abscond and the Kingslayer lunge; the facing rule on Petrifying Gaze stated as the answer to a Hijacked ult; Grievous Wounds tied to Kingslayer's heal.

edits.before: His R (Hijack) steals your Petrifying Gaze — never fire your stun into a 1v1 he can copy and turn back on you; hold it to punish his E commit or use it when his R is down.
edits.after: Hijack (80s at rank 1, only 30s at rank 3) steals Petrifying Gaze — do not fire your stun into a 1v1 he can copy. If he casts it back at you, turn your back: facing away only slows.

edits.before: Malignance or early Liandry's plus your passive move speed make you a kiting DPS monster — drop W to ground his E dash and chain Twin Fangs faster than his W can heal.
edits.after: Malignance or early Liandry's plus your passive move speed make you a kiting DPS monster — Miasma grounds Abscond and the Kingslayer lunge both, and Twin Fang out-ticks his heal.

edits.before: Ground his E dash with W (Miasma) so he cannot chain-stun you or escape your poison cloud
edits.after: Miasma grounds both his dashes — Abscond and the Kingslayer lunge — so he cannot close or leave

edits.before: Sustain through your poke with W heal and win the long fight, or roam after a CS lead
edits.after: Sustain through poke with Kingslayer's heal — without Grievous Wounds he wins the long fight

edits.before: This is your window. Ranks in Q and E let you fire near-continuous Twin Fangs, and the moment Sylas E-dashes in, drop W under him — the ground disables his second dash and his escape, and your ramping Twin Fang melts him while he is stuck in your poison. The one trap is level 6: he steals your Petrifying Gaze with his R (Hijack), so never waste your stun into a clean 1v1 he can copy and reverse onto you — hold it to catch his E commit or save it for when his R is on cooldown.
edits.after: This is your window. Ranks in Q and E let you fire near-continuous Twin Fang casts, and the moment Sylas dashes in with Abscond, drop W under him — the grounding kills the recast and the Kingslayer lunge both, and your ramping Twin Fang melts him while he is stuck in your poison. The trap is level 6: Hijack steals your Petrifying Gaze on 80s falling to 30s, so never spend your stun into a clean 1v1 — and if he fires it back at you, turn your back, because facing away only slows.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Check it before every step-up. - W Miasma is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — 13s at rank 1, 9s maxed. Step up when it is spent. - Kingslayer is 12s and also a dash, so Miasma grounds it too. - W Miasma is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - Hijack is only 30s at rank 3.
